purpose: 冻结 Source→Block→Claim 的确定性生产边界；Claim 是来源证据指针，不是已理解的业务事实。
canonical_bytes: UTF-8 JSON, recursively Unicode-code-point-sorted object keys, arrays preserved, no spaces, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, trailing LF

input_contract.source: immutable UTF-8 source snapshot selected by task5-source-page-manifest-v2
input_contract.normalization: raw bytes and raw coordinates remain authoritative; CRLF/CR→LF and NFKC are derived views only
input_contract.source_scope: one source snapshot per ledger; no cross-source merge

block_parser.unit_order: source byte order, then start byte, end byte, block kind
boundary_rules: fenced code/config is one block per fenced region and is never split by punctuation
each non-empty table cell is one block with its row/column locator; cells never merge across columns
each list item is one block; nested items keep parent/list locator
headings, paragraphs, quotes, image captions and resolved link targets keep their own source spans
blank separators are not blocks, but a non-empty source is not complete unless every text-bearing unit is covered
block_parser.coverage_invariant: text-bearing units form a non-overlapping, source-order-complete partition; every unit has exactly one block_id and every block span replays to the snapshot bytes

claim_ledger.claim_role: raw evidence pointer; semantic support is assigned only after ClaimSemanticFrame and relation validation
claim_ledger.claim_granularity: exactly one EvidenceClaim for each parsed text-bearing Block; no sentence splitting, cross-block merging or external claim generation
claim_ledger.coverage_invariant: claim_keys are unique; every parsed block has exactly one claim; no claim points outside its owner block; source closure is the union of its selected block and claim ids
claim_ledger.state_boundary: extracted|supported|unsupported|conflict are distinct; extraction never implies semantic support
claim_ledger.public_projection: Reader/Audit may expose claim_id, source/block identity, hashes and relative locator; raw claim text is not copied into failure evidence or public Audit index
